# Retainer Renewal / Monthly Check-In Message — [Client]

Short, value-first message sent with (or just after) the monthly optimization report. Adjust tone per client; send via their preferred channel (email/WhatsApp).

---

Hi [First name],

Your monthly Helios AI report is attached/below. Quick summary:

- **This month we:** [2–3 concrete items — e.g. "updated your FAQs with the new prices, fixed the booking link on mobile, and reviewed all 34 inquiries."]
- **Lead flow:** [one factual line — e.g. "34 inquiries, 12 booking requests" — or "we recommend connecting X so we can report on this next month."]
- **Next month we'll:** [1–2 planned improvements]

**One thing we need from you:** [single action item, or "nothing needed this month."]

Anything changing on your side — prices, hours, services, holidays? Reply here and we'll update your assistant the same week; that's what the retainer is for.

Thanks,
[Name] — Helios AI

---

**If the client has gone quiet / renewal is at risk, add:**

> We want to make sure the monthly retainer keeps earning its place. If there's anything you're not seeing enough of — updates, reporting, improvements — tell us and we'll adjust the focus. And if your situation has changed, we can also look at pausing or right-sizing the plan.

*(Never pressure. A right-sized plan retains better than an oversold one.)*
